panels.description: The granddaughter looks from the broken component to Alex. Leave upper-left clear.
Alex looks across Lake Keel toward the paling horizon. Leave upper-right clear.
A quiet beat on Alex's face as memory catches. Leave generous negative space.
Lake Keel under first gray light, boathouse and figures small at the edge. No new threat or clue.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: When you don’t have anything, some people take the easy way out.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: It wasn’t always easy for me, either...
